No. FIRMS recorded no thermal detections within ASSET-F07 (rural property) between 26 September and 26 October 2026. The search covered the whole property boundary and counted any detection footprint that intersected it. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of the period. The data is as of 12 November 2026.

This does not prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The result also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change on the land, or anything outside this period. Note too that the data is near real time, so it is a current reading rather than a final one.
